# Temporary UDF validation and deliberately unsupported forms.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/user-defined-functions.md

@{test_hint = 1} CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (x); SELECT 1
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x DATE) RETURNS FLOAT64 LANGUAGE js AS 'return 1'; SELECT 1
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(`x-y` FLOAT64) RETURNS FLOAT64 LANGUAGE js AS 'return 1'; SELECT 1
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

# LANGUAGE js takes a function body, not code that closes it and supplies another function.
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() RETURNS FLOAT64 LANGUAGE js AS "}); (function() { return 1;"; SELECT f()
=> error:

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() RETURNS FLOAT64 LANGUAGE js AS "} || function() { return 1;"; SELECT f()
=> error:

BEGIN CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) OPTIONS (description = 'ignored') AS (x); EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN SELECT 1; END
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x FLOAT64) AS ((SELECT SUM(v) FROM UNNEST([x]) AS v)); SELECT f(RAND())
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x ANY TYPE) AS ((SELECT SUM(v) FROM UNNEST([x]) AS v)); SELECT f(RAND())
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x ANY TYPE) AS (x); SELECT SAFE.f(1)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x ANY TYPE) AS (x); CREATE VIEW go_udf_views.v AS SELECT f(1) AS x
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION parse_number(x STRING) AS (CAST(x AS INT64)); SELECT SAFE.parse_number('invalid')
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) OPTIONS (description = 'ignored') AS (x); SELECT 1
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (x); CREATE VIEW go_udf_views.v AS SELECT ABS(f(1)) AS x
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION d.f(x INT64) AS (x); SELECT 1
=> error:

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION `d.f`(x INT64) AS (x); SELECT 1
=> error:

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (x); SELECT f('wrong type')
=> error:

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (x); SELECT f(1, 2)
=> error:

DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT 1; CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() AS (x); SELECT f()
=> error:

DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT 1; CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(y ANY TYPE) AS (x + y); SELECT f(1)
=> error:

# third_party/bigquery_docs/user-defined-functions.md
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x ANY TYPE) AS (x + 1); SELECT f('a')
=> error:

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x ANY TYPE) AS (x); SELECT f(1, 2)
=> error:

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x FLOAT64) AS (1 / x); SELECT f(0)
=> error:

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x FLOAT64) AS (x); SELECT f(1 / 0)
=> error:

# A temporary function does not outlive its query, and names differing only in case are the same.
SELECT foo(1)
=> error:

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() AS (1); CREATE TEMP FUNCTION F() AS (2); SELECT f()
=> error:

# OR REPLACE and IF NOT EXISTS cannot be combined.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/data-definition-language.md
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP FUNCTION IF NOT EXISTS f() AS (1); SELECT f()
=> error:

# Answers collected from BigQuery: temporary UDF replacement is rejected.
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (x + 1);
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION g(x INT64) AS (f(x));
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (x + 2);
SELECT g(1)
=> error contains: Clauses such as IF NOT EXISTS are not yet supported with CREATE TEMP FUNCTION

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x ANY TYPE) AS (x + 1);
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION g(x ANY TYPE) AS (f(x));
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP FUNCTION f(x ANY TYPE) AS (x + 2);
SELECT g(1)
=> error contains: Clauses such as IF NOT EXISTS are not yet supported with CREATE TEMP FUNCTION

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (x + 1);
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (f(x) + 1);
SELECT f(1)
=> error contains: Clauses such as IF NOT EXISTS are not yet supported with CREATE TEMP FUNCTION

# BigQuery rejects both creation modes for typed SQL, templated SQL and JavaScript UDFs.
# Answers collected from BigQuery.
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP FUNCTION f() AS (1);
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP FUNCTION F() AS (2);
SELECT f()
=> error contains: Clauses such as IF NOT EXISTS are not yet supported with CREATE TEMP FUNCTION

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION IF NOT EXISTS f() AS (1);
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION IF NOT EXISTS F() AS (2);
SELECT f()
=> error contains: Clauses such as IF NOT EXISTS are not yet supported with CREATE TEMP FUNCTION

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (x);
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP FUNCTION f(x STRING) AS (x);
SELECT f('replaced')
=> error contains: Clauses such as IF NOT EXISTS are not yet supported with CREATE TEMP FUNCTION

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (x);
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION IF NOT EXISTS f(x STRING) AS (x);
SELECT f(1)
=> error contains: Clauses such as IF NOT EXISTS are not yet supported with CREATE TEMP FUNCTION

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP FUNCTION f(x ANY TYPE) AS (x);
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP FUNCTION f(x ANY TYPE) AS (x + 1);
SELECT f(1)
=> error contains: Clauses such as IF NOT EXISTS are not yet supported with CREATE TEMP FUNCTION

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION IF NOT EXISTS f(x ANY TYPE) AS (x);
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION IF NOT EXISTS f(x ANY TYPE) AS (x + 1);
SELECT f(1)
=> error contains: Clauses such as IF NOT EXISTS are not yet supported with CREATE TEMP FUNCTION

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP FUNCTION f() RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE js AS 'return "first"';
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP FUNCTION F() RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE js AS 'return "second"';
SELECT f()
=> error contains: Clauses such as IF NOT EXISTS are not yet supported with CREATE TEMP FUNCTION

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION IF NOT EXISTS f() RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE js AS 'return "first"';
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION IF NOT EXISTS F() RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE js AS 'return "second"';
SELECT f()
=> error contains: Clauses such as IF NOT EXISTS are not yet supported with CREATE TEMP FUNCTION
